content.text: Implement ISSUE-0008 - Dispatch CLI commands over the wired modules.

content.thinking: One entry point, four commands. Arguments come from process arguments only; an unknown command or a wrong argument count exits non-zero with the reason on standard error.

input.content: const COMMANDS = { add, list, report, export: exportCsv }

content.text: The CLI dispatches add, list, report and export, writes results to standard output and refusals to standard error. The unknown-command exit code is still owed a test.
